claims.text: The starting coating consists of nanoscale alternating FCC and BCC high-entropy-alloy layers with coherent interfaces containing local short-range order.
Sustained loading progressively disrupts short-range order at FCC/BCC multilayer interfaces.
Interfacial short-range order initially impedes dislocation motion or transmission.
Disruption of short-range order reduces interface strength and the effective barrier to dislocation transmission.
Disruption of interfacial short-range order reduces stacking-fault energy.
A reduced interfacial barrier promotes increased dislocation transmission and slip.
Evolution of interfacial short-range order governs the transition from an initial elastic response to progressive creep plasticity.
Dislocations nucleate primarily in the softer FCC layers.
FCC/BCC interfaces impede dislocations and cause interfacial pile-ups.
Dislocation pile-ups generate local stress concentrations.
Stress concentrations from interfacial dislocation accumulation progressively disrupt short-range order.
Incipient deformation-induced hcp formation can further accommodate plastic strain.
Sustained loading will increase dislocation density, particularly near FCC/BCC interfaces.
Sustained loading will produce a detectable loss or alteration of interfacial short-range order.
The creep response will transition from an initially slow rate to more pronounced plastic deformation.
Multilayers with enhanced interfacial short-range order will show later onset and a lower rate of plastic deformation than multilayers with suppressed short-range order.
The intact-SRO starting multilayer exhibits limited plastic deformation under low to moderate stress.
At sufficiently high temperatures or stresses, lattice diffusion or phase transformations can overtake the proposed interface-mediated mechanism.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis says SRO disruption enables enhanced dislocation pile-up, whereas the mechanism says dislocation pile-up occurs first and causes SRO disruption. A feedback loop could reconcile these directions, but none is explicitly stated.
